scheme_name: Admission of Adi Dravidar/Tribal Students in Plus One at Reputed Schools
other_conditions: Must be currently enrolled in school
Must have secured the highest marks in Class X from Government/Corporation/Municipal/Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare schools
Must be among the top 10 students selected from each district
Eligibility category noted in source: Adi Dravidar
Eligibility category noted in source: Tribal
benefits_summary: Free admission into reputed private schools for Plus One with tuition and boarding coverage up to ₹28,000 per year
